parameter_matrix.note: Check PCB land pattern & height profile.
Wider operating Vin window supports broader rail & battery chemistry headroom.
Higher Vin,abs improves survivability against hot-plug and inductive bus spikes.
Tighter Vout tolerance improves ADC reference and digital rail margin.
Actual usable continuous Iout is also bounded by package θJA thermal derating.
Lower Iq directly extends sleep-mode battery life in always-on IoT/portable rails.
Lower dropout allows regulation deeper into Li-ion / 3.7 V discharge curves.
Non-ceramic-stable LDOs oscillate with low-ESR MLCCs unless series resistance or tantalum is used.
Higher PSRR attenuates upstream switching-converter ripple on analog/RF rails.
Critical for RF VCOs, low-noise ADCs, and precision sensor excitation.
Lower θJA yields lower junction temperature rise ΔTj = (Vin - Vout) × Iout × θJA.
Keep steady-state Tj at least 15–25 °C below Tj,max for production reliability.

swap_risks: CAUTION PACKAGE HEIGHT/PROFILE: CAT6219-330TD-GT3 (TSOT-23-5) vs LP2985-33DBVR (SOT-23-5) share the same JEDEC land pattern pitch, but thin-profile TSOT (~1.0 mm) vs standard SOT (~1.45 mm) differs in body height; verify enclosure Z-clearance, SMT nozzle height, and solder fillet spec.
HIGH INPUT VOLTAGE RATING DROP: CAT6219-330TD-GT3 is rated to only 5.5 V rec. (6.5 V abs max, p.3) vs LP2985-33DBVR at 16 V rec. (16 V abs max, p.4). Verify worst-case input transient spikes.
HIGH LOAD CURRENT DERATING: LP2985-33DBVR supplies up to 150 mA (p.4) compared to CAT6219-330TD-GT3 at 500 mA (p.4); confirm peak inrush and thermal dissipation margin.
CAUTION LIFECYCLE STATUS (EOL): CAT6219-330TD-GT3 is flagged EOL by onsemi; do not design into new production layouts — evaluate Active alternatives.
engineering_verdict: CAT6219-330TD-GT3 (onsemi, TSOT-23-5) and LP2985-33DBVR (Texas Instruments, SOT-23-5) are Level 2 Functional / Tuning Required replacements: while the footprint is physically compatible, engineering review and passive/circuit adjustments are mandatory due to Vin,max rating drops >20%; Iout,max rating drops >20%. Key datasheet deltas: Iq is 55 µA (p.4) vs 69 µA (p.6), max output current is 500 mA (p.4) vs 150 mA (p.4), recommended Vin,max is 5.5 V (p.3) vs 16 V (p.4), typical dropout is 300 mV (p.4) vs 180 mV (p.6), and ceramic capacitor stability is supported vs supported. Always validate pinout orientation (TOP_VIEW p.2 vs TOP_VIEW p.3), thermal margin (θJA 235 vs 178.6 °C/W), and official manufacturer datasheets on hardware prototypes before production release.
